title: Essences via Overlord's Domain
summary: Stack essence content on maps with a Powerful Map Boss: Overlord's Domain and The Chosen Path add essences, Overseer tablets add more, and Hilda's Mighty Prey makes Powerful bosses — which the Domain needs — more common.

budget.build_needs: Clears T15+ waystones and kills the map boss; no pinnacle damage needed.

claim.note: Editorial estimate from what the setup needs; not measured.

yields.why: One of the Crystalline Patterns groups; Flawless Patterns raises Perfect essence finds.
One of the Crystalline Patterns groups; Flawless Patterns raises Perfect essence finds.
Crystalline Patterns can target the Haste/Alacrity group.
Crystalline Patterns can target the Infinite group.

nodes.name: Mighty Prey
nodes.effect: 25% chance to upgrade Map Bosses to Powerful Map Bosses

nodes.name: Ancient Inscriptions
nodes.effect: 8% increased effect of Explicit Modifiers on Tablets for each type of Tablet affecting Map area

nodes.name: Claimed Territories
nodes.effect: Overlord's Influence and Overlord's Domain Atlas Passive Skills have 45% chance to add twice as much content

atlas_master.alt: Doryani T1 Archaic Corruption (new in 0.5.5): Monsters released from Essences become Corrupted — its value for this basket is untested.

claim.note: Our synthesis: Overlord's Domain only adds content where the Map Boss is Powerful; Mighty Prey upgrades bosses and Claimed Territories can double the Domain's content. Not measured.

atlas_passives.name: Overlord's Domain
atlas_passives.effect: Add additional content to areas with Powerful Map Bosses — options: 1 additional Essences; a Summoning Circle and Reactivation Runes; 1 additional Rogue Exiles. Take Essences.

atlas_passives.name: The Chosen Path
atlas_passives.effect: 100% increased chance of a certain content type — options include Essences. Take Essences.

atlas_passives.name: Inexplicable Alchemy
atlas_passives.effect: Exalted Orbs may be used to add Essences to Essence Monsters, up to 1 additional Essences

atlas_passives.name: Crystalline Overgrowth
atlas_passives.effect: Essence Monsters have 15% chance to have an additional Essence

atlas_passives.name: Flawless Patterns
atlas_passives.effect: 30% increased chance to find Perfect Essences

atlas_passives.name: Crystalline Patterns
atlas_passives.effect: 100% increased chance to find certain Essence types — pick one Greater/Perfect group (Battle, Sorcery, Haste/Alacrity, Infinite, Seeking, Opulence, Command)

atlas_passives.name: Intensifying Energies
atlas_passives.effect: Essence Monsters have 10% Surpassing chance to have an additional Essence per Explicit Modifier on the Map

claim.note: No search button: trade2 lists two stats reading 'Map contains an additional Essence' (395808938, 2162684861) and which one this suffix uses is unconfirmed.

mods.text: Map has (70–100)% increased chance to contain Essences

waystone.notes: No source ties waystone totals to essence drops; rarity totals pay off on the rest of the map.

claim.note: Editorial default. poe2db confirms 0.5 waystone mods bundle difficulty with these reward totals, not what they do for essences.

steps: Allocate The Chosen Path and Overlord's Domain, both on Essences.
Set Hilda: Mighty Prey, Ancient Inscriptions, Claimed Territories.
Slot an Overseer Tablet rolled with 'of Crystals' or 'of the Essence'.
Kill the map boss and open every essence monster; sell Greater and Perfect essences on the Currency Exchange.
risks: Overlord's Domain adds nothing where the Map Boss is not Powerful.
'of Crystals' has no pinned trade stat, so it has no search button.
The basket shows unit prices only; how many Perfect essences a map yields is unknown.
